hadith:
Food, Meals - Narrated Abu Juhaifa:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I do not take my meals while leaning (against something).
message: Purify yourself, remember your Lord, and remain steadfast in prayer—these are signs of true success. Practice humility even in daily habits, and place your trust in Allah, Al-Wakeel, while doing your best.
name:
Al Wakeel - الْوَكِيلُ - The Trustee

The name implies that Allah is the ultimate protector and guardian of His creation, handling all matters and ensuring they are done justly and in accordance with His wisdom. The name Al Wakeel is derived from the Arabic root 'w-k-l', which means 'to appoint, to designate, or to entrust'. It appears in Islamic texts and emphasizes the reliance of creation on Allah's management.
verse:
Al-A'la - The Most High - 87:14-15

Successful indeed are those who purify themselves, remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.
